identifier_status: Stable repository-local identifiers; no DOI or public persistent resolver has been registered.
compatibility_policy: Display names and family identifiers are additive metadata. Historical phase numbers, process-area IDs, scenario IDs, workbook sheets, and API request fields remain unchanged.

families.context_scope: Technology performance is feedstock-, configuration-, and operating-condition-specific. Feed composition and contaminant assays are material- and site-specific.
families.activation_note: Use only route choices already active in the selected GreenHub configuration; staged hydrothermal, PEF, and thermal/enzymatic evidence does not activate those routes.

families.context_scope: Recovery yield, reagent demand, quality, fouling, and drying response depend on feedstock, juice composition, and the specific operating envelope.
families.activation_note: PR scenario IDs and existing data gates remain authoritative; staged routes remain inactive until their gates pass.

technology_subfamilies: interlaboratory BMP assay quality and reproducibility
families.context_scope: Kinetics and methane yields are substrate-, inoculum-, temperature-, loading-, and residence-time-specific. Stoichiometry and balance methods may be shared where definitions and units match.
families.activation_note: Do not transfer a substrate-calibrated kinetic coefficient to another waste stream without validation.

families.context_scope: Vendor envelopes and separation equations are technology-specific; methane recovery, slip, utility use, and consumables depend on inlet gas composition, scale, and operating conditions.
families.activation_note: This is a child technology family in the digestion-to-biomethane route; existing BG IDs and gates remain unchanged.

families.context_scope: Nutrient speciation, recovery, product grade, chemical demand, contaminants, and fertilizer substitution depend on digestate composition and local product requirements.
families.activation_note: Existing NR IDs and evidence gates remain unchanged; recovery is not equivalent to saleable-product or fertilizer-substitution evidence.

families.context_scope: Equipment capacity and separation performance depend on the slurry, particle distribution, and vendor configuration; equipment models can be reused only after those inputs are checked.
families.activation_note: A cross-cutting family; it does not create a new process route or scenario ID.

families.context_scope: Equipment-specific duties may transfer within validated envelopes; tariffs, grid factors, ambient conditions, and operating schedules are site- and project-specific.
families.activation_note: Utility datasets remain separately identified from process chemistry and product recovery.
